cover: Drones kill four, hit UN building
Author held at airport over book

stories.label: Sudan's war
stories.head: Drones hit homes and a UN building
bullets: Three were killed in one Omdurman home on 22 Nov.
A UN building was damaged with staff inside.
No RSF comment; the UN called it 'unacceptable'.

stories.label: Palestine
stories.head: Settlers attack villages near Ramallah
bullets: Three villages hit before dawn on 22 Nov.
Israeli police opened an investigation; no arrests reported.

stories.label: India · Due process
stories.head: Left in no-man's land
bullets: Women and children among the group, reports say.
Bangladesh's border guard says India's BSF tried to push them in.
BSF denied sending them, bdnews24 reported.

stories.label: India · Speech
stories.head: Author Ravi Hanj taken into custody
bullets: Held on 21 Nov under a lookout notice.
Karnataka's Cabinet ordered his book seized.
Police cite FIRs for promoting enmity; Hanj apologised.
